perks.name: Photogalvanic
perks.description: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving ANY healing while not at Full HP:
+20? Handling, +10 Reload Speed, 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier, and ?% Flinch Resist for Solar Weapons for 4 seconds.
Works with ANY source of healing, such as Orb Pickups. Restoration constantly refreshes it

perks.name: Cauterize
perks.description: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each:
Restores 30 HP.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between heals.

Armor configured for Guardians that take the word "impossible" as a challenge.

Primary Stat: Weapons
Secondary Stat: Super

item.name: Powerful Attraction
item.description: Automatically collects nearby Orbs of Power when you activate your class ability.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
Collects Orbs of Power within 12.5 | 18.5 metres.

Will also pick up Motes and Crests.

item.name: Time Dilation
item.description: Your decaying Armor Charge has a longer duration.
item.exact:
Armor Charges decay every 15 | 18 | 20 seconds.

By default, an Armor Charge stack is removed every 10 seconds if a Passive Mod is equipped.
